videos.t: What's the outlook for US energy prices ahead of the midterms? | FT #shorts
videos.d: In the FT’s latest episode of the Economics Show with Soumaya Keynes, commentator and analyst Rory Johnston talks through how high oil prices could still go and why what you pay at the pump doesn’t reflect the cost of unrefined oil.⁠
